Page resolution in the PDF, measured along the long side of A4: 150 dpi = 1754 px, 300 dpi = 3508 px, 600 dpi = 7016 px. Auto uses the most the camera can give (up to 6000 px). The app asks the camera for a photo of that size; if memory runs short, the size is lowered automatically and the app does not close.

⚡ Quick scan: one tap, a ready PDF.

📐 Frame: fit the sheet in the A4 frame on the screen.
🎯 Auto: the camera finds the edges of the sheet and straightens it by itself.
⚠️ In Auto mode the app warns you if the sheet doesn’t fit in the view or can’t be seen: move the phone farther away.
📷 The photo size follows the PDF quality chosen in Settings (150 / 300 / 600 dpi or Auto). In the dark the flash fires by itself, and the app waits until the phone is steady before shooting.
💾 You choose the file name; the PDF is saved in the background.

%1$s

📷 Scan: choose Frame or Auto, then tap Capture. The item is placed on an A4 sheet at its real size.

🎯 Auto: no size to pick. The camera finds the item by itself and, when the whole item is in view and the phone is steady, takes the photo automatically. The page is placed on the A4 sheet with its shape preserved.
📐 Frame: pick a size under the switch and fit the item in the frame.
💳 ID card: driver’s license, residence permit, national ID, bank card; both sides go on one sheet.
🧾 Receipt: a long strip can be continued with another part.
⚠️ In Auto mode the app warns you if the item doesn’t fit in the view or can’t be seen.
💾 You choose the file name; the PDF is saved in the background.
